job.title: Business Analyst E-Commerce - Fluent German & English (m/f/d)
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

You need an analyst who turns e-commerce data and requirements into clear decisions – I have done that for 5+ years in large e-commerce environments at Rockwell Automation and Shell.

– Analysed requirements with business stakeholders, wrote user stories and functional specifications, supported UAT
– Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed
– Used generative AI / LLM tools extensively across analysis, development, testing and documentation

I am used to coordinating across international business and technical teams. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. Would you have 15 minutes for a short call in the coming days? My CV and cover letter are attached.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: Business Analyst E-Commerce | Requirements, Data Analysis & Process Optimisation
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional business analyst with 5+ years in large e-commerce environments (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Analyses business requirements with stakeholders, maps processes, performs gap analysis and turns findings into clear user stories and functional specifications. Confident with large datasets through SQL, query optimization and product, catalog, pricing and order data across global channels. Uses generative AI tools for faster analysis and documentation. Structured, hands-on and used to coordinating across international business and technical teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: Gauder has grown to 100,000+ monthly orders with a clear mission: home improvement products that last. I like the founder-close set-up with real ownership from day one. My five years in large e-commerce environments, from requirements analysis to SQL-based data work on catalogs, pricing and orders, fit your focus on scaling channels and markets.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, your Business Analyst E-Commerce role at Gauder interests me: 5+ years in large e-commerce environments for Rockwell Automation and Shell – requirements analysis, process mapping, SQL, catalog/pricing/order data. Berlin-ready, start 16.12.2026. Open to a call?

en.subject: Application: Business Analyst E-Commerce
en.hook: Gauder is scaling fast across channels and countries, and you need an analyst who turns data and requirements into clear decisions and well-run projects. I bring more than five years in large e-commerce operations for Rockwell Automation and Shell, working between business stakeholders and IT on catalogs, pricing, promotions and orders across global channels.

bullets.label: Structured problem-solving
bullets.text: Analysed business requirements with stakeholders, mapped processes and wrote user stories and functional specifications; supported user acceptance testing (UAT).

bullets.label: Working with large datasets
bullets.text: Worked daily with SQL on product, catalog, pricing and order data; led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed.

bullets.label: Project ownership across teams
bullets.text: Investigated and resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee together with international technical teams; engineered API migrations for customer account structures.

bullets.label: Fast, AI-supported analysis
bullets.text: Used generative AI / LLM tools extensively to accelerate analysis, testing and documentation.

en.logistics: I know first-hand how promotions, catalogs and order flows drive e-commerce revenue, and I communicate clearly with both management and technical teams. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would be glad to discuss how I can support your next growth steps.
